_doc: Emission factors used for ALL carbon figures. Verified 10 Oct 2026 against the DESNZ 2025 GHG conversion factors flat file (rows quoted by ID). Carbon = sum over fuels of delta_kWh x factor. Electricity at the meter = generation (Scope 2) + transmission & distribution (Scope 3) so that a kWh saved at the home is valued consistently. Gas uses the Gross CV factor because meter/bill kWh are on a gross calorific value basis. Well-to-tank factors are excluded (documented choice).

source.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero (DESNZ)
source.title: Greenhouse gas reporting: conversion factors 2025 (flat format)

generation_scope2.label: UK electricity, Electricity generated, Electricity: UK, kWh, kg CO2e

transmission_distribution_scope3.label: T&D- UK electricity, Electricity: UK, kWh, kg CO2e

gas.label: Fuels, Gaseous fuels, Natural gas, kWh (Gross CV), kg CO2e

net_cv_alternative.note: Only if consumption is reported on a net CV basis

not_yet_supported_rule: Homes whose main fuel is not electricity or mains gas get carbon_saving = null with a warning until a sourced factor is added here.
